concerns.description: Minor text differences beyond acceptable reformatting
concerns.analysis: On page 10, the source PDF contains a typo in an expenditure amount, stating '$13,8086,413,305' (an extra digit). The extraction pipeline 'corrected' this typo by changing it to '$13,806,413,305'. While likely an attempt to fix a source error, this constitutes a clear textual alteration of a specific dollar amount.
concerns.location: Page 10, Division of Medicaid Assistance - Medicaid Analytics Pilot

concerns.analysis: In 'Appendix A - Legislation' on page 18, the sub-list hierarchy is flattened and incorrectly nested. In the source PDF, item '(1)' and '(2)' are nested under '(f)', and items 'a.' and 'b.' are nested under '(1)'. In the JSON output, item '(2)' is extracted as a top-level sibling to '(f)', and items 'a.' and 'b.' under '(1)' are extracted as siblings to '(1)' rather than its children.
